name: reviews-to-write
title: Reviews to write
description: Delivered products waiting for a review: a star pick per product that folds into a thank-you, with Write a review and a Skip that can be undone.
docs: Pass items: id, name, an optional variant, image, href and reviewHref, deliveredAt (an ISO date, written as '12 May' in locale and timeZone) and an optional rating when the customer already gave stars somewhere else, such as an order email: the row then starts as a thank-you. Picking a star calls onRate(id, rating). A click or a tap answers at once; with the keyboard the arrow keys move through the stars and Space or Enter gives the answer, as does moving focus away from them; only three seconds without a change give it for the person. The row folds into 'Thanks, you gave it 4 out of 5: Very good.' with an 'Add a few words' link, an anchor when the item has reviewHref and otherwise a button that calls onWrite(id, rating), and a 'Change' button that brings the stars back so a slip can be put right: the next answer calls onRate again. Return a promise from onRate: if it rejects, the row goes back to its stars and says so. Skip calls onSkip(id), closes the row and shows a toast with Undo, which calls onUnskip(id): mount the RHS UI Toaster once in your app. Focus follows the row that folds, leaves or comes back, a polite status says what happened, and when nothing is left an empty state says so kindly. ratingWords and every other word are in labels.
